context.issue: Buttons (create, edit, delete) not responding to clicks for administrator user

finding.issue: Button component expects 'onclick' prop (line 14) but dispatches 'on:click' event (line 61)
finding.details: - The Button component has both onclick prop and on:click event handling - handleClick function checks for onclick prop first (line 56) - Only dispatches the event if onclick is not provided

finding.issue: Using Svelte 4 'on:click' syntax instead of 'onclick' prop

finding.verification: is_editable field is correctly calculated based on user permissions
finding.details: - Admin users can edit/delete all articles (shared and personal) - Regular users can only edit/delete their own articles - is_editable flag is correctly set in ArticlePublic.from_db_model()

analysis.root_cause: Mismatch between Button component implementation and articles page usage. The Button component has been updated to use 'onclick' prop but the articles page still uses the old Svelte 4 'on:click' event binding syntax.
analysis.solution: Update all Button components in the articles page to use 'onclick' prop instead of 'on:click' event binding. This will ensure proper event handling and make buttons responsive again.
